facts.text: A complete simulation platform is a commercial or open-source product that tries to cover scenarios, environments, sensors, vehicle motion and test execution within one product.
facts.quote: A complete simulation platform is a commercial or open-source product that tries to cover several layers of the tool chain at once: scenarios, environments, sensors, vehicle motion and test execution.

facts.text: Complete simulation platforms usually still rely on a separate machine model, controller, asset pipeline or hardware bench; “complete” is relative.
facts.quote: "complete" is relative: these products usually still rely on a separate machine model, controller, asset pipeline or hardware bench [Chapter 11]

facts.text: For simulation-platform evidence, “demonstrated” means documented customer use, a peer-reviewed study, a government program or a shipped example.
facts.quote: "Demonstrated" means a documented customer use, peer-reviewed study, government program or shipped example

facts.text: For simulation-platform evidence, “claimed” means a vendor statement only.
facts.quote: "claimed" means a vendor statement only

facts.text: For simulation-platform evidence, “on-road only” means proven for road vehicles with no off-road evidence found.
facts.quote: "on-road only" means proven for road vehicles with no off-road evidence found

facts.text: The platform table treats “not found” as a finding, not a gap.
facts.quote: "Not found" is a finding, not a gap.
